generation.mode: single built-in ImageGen whole-canvas edit with edit-target.png first and the NinjaOne seed canon second as reference only

lightingIsotropy.metric: 36-bin full-angle land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by the uniform-bin mean on the delivered source; final water-mask pixels and immediate neighbours excluded and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lightingIsotropy.visualCheck: No cast-shadow field or whole-cell sun gradient is obvious, but basalt and boulders repeatedly use pale upper planes over darker vertical faces. The low aggregate directional moment cannot override the literal equal-value rule.

buildableVsSteepFraction.basis: manual full-frame estimate as fractions of non-water land at native source resolution
buildableVsSteepFraction.method: The coherent gold-green central shelf and broad even northern run count as buildable; exposed basalt risers and incised banks count as steep; rocky biome transitions, talus, vegetation, the rune cut and panel footprints make up the remainder.

crown.method: Full-frame native-resolution dark-conifer connected-component census of all 42 detected crown components, including saplings and clipped edge crowns; median source width 20.5 px was scaled by 2560/1254 and converted at 0.048 m per final pixel.

waterMask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
waterMask.method: Native-resolution bank-to-bank traces of the connected shallow stream and pool, including their full painted shallow margins, wash, ripple highlights, reflections and water between stones; the binary overlay was inspected at native resolution.

runeChain.visualRead: The feature has a dark recessed centre between stone lips, but the lips are regular enough to risk reading as a stone-lined channel or kerb instead of an eroded bedrock slot.

refusalReasons: The highest-priority lighting rule fails visually: repeated pale rock top planes and darker vertical faces retain orientation-dependent form lighting even though no cast-shadow field is present.
The rune-chain groove misses both exact seam handoffs: its traced centre reaches the west edge near source y=624 instead of 564.3 and the east edge near y=692 instead of 627.0.
The rune-chain stone lips are too regular to be unambiguously read as a weathered slot removed from bedrock; they risk reading as a stone-lined channel or kerb.
openRisks: The crown census includes every detected component and no exclusions, but overlapping painted crowns can merge into one connected component; final scale judgment remains visual.
The water mask is same-size, binary, connected and overlay-inspected; exact bank placement remains a human visual gate.
The cell remains quarantine-only. No shipped-canvas bake, runtime validation, public asset write or art-source write was performed.
recommendedReframe: Do not spend a prompt-only quality retry on this square result. A future attempt needs deterministic seam guides for the rune-chain handoffs and an authoring path that can enforce flat-value rock faces.
